03 — Our approach

Every home should
tell its own story.

UNICA was created around a simple belief: individuality belongs in the spaces we live in. Egyptian craftsmanship, modern design sensibilities and personal expression come together to make spaces feel truly yours.

04 — Our story

Rooted in
Egypt.
Made personal.

“Unica” is derived from the word unique, reflecting our belief that every home should tell its own story.

As the sister company of Firma Designs and Kayan Candles, UNICA was born from the desire to bring accessible luxury, personalized décor and creative interiors to a wider audience in Egypt.

We focus on home accessories, furniture and interior styling, combining Egyptian craftsmanship with modern design sensibilities. UNICA represents warmth, individuality and innovation, making every space feel truly personal.

05 — The people

Meet the
founders.

Two creative backgrounds brought together through architecture, interiors, product design, craftsmanship and a shared belief in meaningful spaces.

Doula Al Shakankiry
Co-Founder · Business Director · Architect

Business director and co-founder of Firma Designs & Firma Shop, with 18 years of experience across architecture, interior design and product design.

Hagar El Kady
Co-Founder · Architectural Engineer

An architectural engineering graduate and founder of Kayan Candles, bringing a product-focused approach and a strong appreciation for handcrafted objects.
